title: Multi-Value Alignment for LLMs via Value Decorrelation and Extrapolation
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Models with human values for safety and ethics. It evaluates its proposed Multi-Value Alignment (MVA) framework using datasets and metrics centered on ethical dimensions such as 'helpfulness', 'harmlessness', 'safety', and 'honesty', and explicitly addresses 'harmful bias' and 'prejudice' in its case study.
